question: ‘Hampi Utsava,’ which is celebrated in Karnataka, is also called ____________. The festival that captures the pomp, splendour and glory of the historical period of Karnataka is celebrated over a week.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijaya Utsava**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hampi Utsava** is celebrated in **Karnataka **and is also known as **Vijaya Utsava**.
 
• This festival captures the pomp, splendour, and glory of the historical period of Karnataka.
 
• It is celebrated over a week and includes various cultural programs, showcasing the rich heritage of the region.
 
• The festival is held in **Hampi**, a UNESCO World Heritage site, which was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• Hampi Utsava is a significant cultural event that attracts tourists from all over the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Vijayanagara Empire** was a South Indian empire based in the Deccan Plateau region, established in 1336 by Harihara I and his brother Bukka Raya I.
 
• Hampi, located in the Ballari district of Karnataka, is known for its ruins, which are a** UNESCO World Heritage site**.
 
• The architectural grandeur of Hampi includes temples, palaces, and market streets, reflecting the prosperity and cultural richness of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
• The **Hampi Utsava** includes performances of traditional dance forms like Bharatnatyam and Kathak, as well as folk dances and music, enhancing the cultural experience for visitors.
 
• Local artisans and craftsmen also showcase their work, providing a glimpse into the traditional arts and crafts of the region.
